api_changes: Public Recipe optimizer_family, eps and cosine beta2/reg_coeff endpoints; shared factories and caller-owned update schedules honor the same settings across Forge hosts. Defaults preserve existing recipes.
changed_factors: Register the previously selected repaired optimizer recipe as one global reusable family candidate with fixed numerical optimizer, penalty, noise and schedule controls across all tasks; declared task-owned geometry/resources/prior/horizons/objectives remain bound by existing adapters.

decision_contract.competing_explanation: The lower word-compatible global rates may be too small for the frozen 80-update movement screen. A failure rejects this complete ordinary candidate; prior word passes cannot fill its gated cells or justify per-task tuning.

base_declaration.hypothesis: The exact repaired global recipe acquires the five-word inverse task and transfers without task-specific optimizer tuning across every eligible required discriminator-stability task under ordinary prerequisites.
base_declaration.mechanism_rationale: Explicit global solution successor. Clean-noise/cap activation boundaries are declared rather than hidden in same-signature search; no new penalty kernel, optimizer family or auxiliary objective. Family membership describes solution lineage.

progression.policy: every declared configuration advances independently through ordinary prerequisites to the tier cap

qualification_scope: declared tuning tasks only; provisional Forge gates

selection.objective: required PASS count by ascending tuning tier (descending); configuration hash (ascending)

spec.hypothesis: Increasing the global network/base rate while retaining the nominal absolute latent-table prior base rate may restore movement within the unchanged 80-update screen. Every complete configuration is then evaluated through all ordinary Tier 3 prerequisites; later failures remain part of this whole-candidate result.
spec.rationale: The completed r1r2-global-repair-v1 first gate had mean_abs=0.03944357112 below .3, with a passing gradient bound. These two coupled global numeric settings hold all existing penalty kernels, intervention flags, moments, noise/schedule laws and task conditions fixed. They preserve nominal latent-table prior base LR 0.0024; direct coordinates instead consume the existing global G-side base LR. Effective feedback rates can differ with training state. No per-task candidate override, new objective, seed study, gate change, repeat of the failed base, or automatic continuation is allowed.

speed_selection.reason: No frozen comparable first-acquisition timing contract is implemented for this search. Not all required adapters record per-observation seconds; original terminal-suffix or coverage-only times cannot supply full-quality first-acquisition speed.
